note: New items only (no edits to finance-sources.json). Collected with Claude in Chrome get_page_text/find on 2026-10-25; WebSearch used only to discover URLs. Excerpts are verbatim page text; where the page is a table, cell line breaks are joined with single spaces.

items.label: TK statutory student health + long-term care insurance, under 23 (no child)
items.applies_to: Compulsorily insured students in Germany (statutory student tariff), under 23 without child, valid from 01.01.2026
items.excerpt_verbatim: Monthly contributions for students with statutory insurance cover - valid from 01.01.2026 Breakdown of the monthly contribution Health insurance Long-term care insurance* Total amount up to 23 years without child 110.38 EUR 30.78 EUR 141.16 EUR
items.notes: Page dated 04.02.2026. Health part 110.38 EUR (includes TK supplementary rate 2.69%) + long-term care 30.78 EUR. Student rate is based on the BAfoeG requirement rate and applies until age 30 (extensions possible). Other insurers' student rates differ only by their own supplementary rate.

items.label: TK statutory student health + long-term care insurance, 23 and over (no child)
items.applies_to: Compulsorily insured students in Germany (statutory student tariff), aged 23-29 without child, valid from 01.01.2026
items.excerpt_verbatim: from 23 years of age without child 110.38 EUR 35.91 EUR 146.29 EUR
items.notes: Same table as de-tk-student-health-2026-under23 (header: 'Monthly contributions for students with statutory insurance cover - valid from 01.01.2026'). Higher long-term care part (35.91) is the childless surcharge from age 23. Most Pakistani Master's students will be 23+.

items.label: TK voluntary insurance minimum for students after student tariff ends (health part only)
items.applies_to: Students voluntarily insured with TK after student insurance expires (e.g. from age 30), with no income, 2026
items.excerpt_verbatim: If you have no income you pay the minimum contribution: Monthly contributions for voluntarily insured students Voluntarily insured students Health insurance* Long-term care insurance up to 23 years without child 220.03 EUR 47.46 EUR
items.notes: Health part only. Long-term care is extra: 47.46 EUR (under 23 / with child) or 55.37 EUR (23+ without child) per the same table. Relevant for PhD students aged 30+.

items.label: Studierendenwerk Muenchen Oberbayern basic fee (TUM semester fee), from summer 2026 onwards
items.applies_to: Students at the 15 universities served by Studierendenwerk Muenchen Oberbayern (incl. TUM Munich/Garching/Weihenstephan), summer semester 2026 onwards, so covers winter semester 2026/27
items.authority: Studierendenwerk Muenchen Oberbayern (Grundbeitragssatzung valid since 1 Oct 2025)
items.excerpt_verbatim: There are currently 15 universities within our jurisdiction. From the summer semester 2026 onwards, the Basic Fee / Studierendenwerk Fee will amount to 97 euros.
items.notes: Same page: solidarity (MVV) fee 'suspended until further notice' since WS 2023/24, so the basic fee is the whole semester fee for TUM's Munich-area campuses. Matches TUM fees page (97.00 EUR, SS 2026); TUM's own page still shows no separate WS 2026/27 figure. Straubing (82 EUR) and Heilbronn are outside this Studierendenwerk. English text; German version legally binding. The optional Deutschlandsemesterticket is not included.

items.label: Italian national study visa (D) fee in PKR, Oct-Dec 2026
items.applies_to: National study visa (type D) applied for in the Consulate General Karachi jurisdiction (Karachi, Quetta BLS centres), October-December 2026
items.excerpt_verbatim: Consular fees vary every three months. From October to December 2026, the fees are as follows: ... National study visa (D) EUR 50,00 PKR 16,250 Payment may be made at the BLS centre where the application is submitted.
items.notes: EUR 50 = existing it-visa-fee-study. PKR amount is reset quarterly. The Islamabad Embassy page (see it-visa-fee-study-pkr-islamabad-q3-2026) had not yet posted Oct-Dec 2026 on 2026-10-25; Karachi's Q4 PKR equals Islamabad's Q3 PKR, so likely identical, but the Islamabad Q4 figure is unconfirmed. The '...' in the excerpt omits other visa types.

items.label: Italian national study visa (D) fee in PKR, Islamabad, Jul-Sep 2026 (latest posted)
items.applies_to: National study visa (type D) in the Embassy Islamabad jurisdiction (Islamabad, Lahore, Multan, Faisalabad BLS centres), July-September 2026; Oct-Dec 2026 not yet posted
items.excerpt_verbatim: From July to September 2026, the fees are as follows: ... National study visa (D) EUR 50,00 PKR 16,250 Payment may be made at the BLS centre where the application is submitted. Update to 24/06/2026
items.notes: Period ended 30 Sep 2026; page not updated for Q4. Same page lists Apr-Jun 2026 as PKR 16,290. Use the Karachi Q4 item as the current reference until Islamabad updates.

items.label: BLS-Intiana visa centre service fee (Italy, Pakistan)
items.applies_to: BLS-Intiana service fee stated by the Consulate Karachi for family reunification (EU citizens' family) appointments at Karachi/Quetta; applicability to study visas not stated
items.excerpt_verbatim: To increase the daily availability of appointments for applicants, appointments will be scheduled at the BLS-Intiana Visa Application Centres in Karachi and Quetta. The only fee payable is the BLS service fee of €35.
items.notes: Only official statement of a BLS fee amount found. It sits in the family-reunification section (where the visa itself is free), so it is a strong hint but not confirmed for study visas. intianaitalyvisa.com returned 403 Forbidden in Chrome too. Same page confirms all visa applications go through VAC BLS-Intiana (Islamabad, Lahore, Multan, Faisalabad, Karachi, Quetta).
